changes: New public per-agent 'Get In Touch' lead-capture landing page at /get-in-touch/:agentId, served for every agent's own QR code (yard signs, open house signs). Displays the agent's photo, name, phone, and a value-proposition pitch on why to hire Brothers Group.
New public API GET /api/public/agents/:id returns safe agent fields (name, phone, headshot) for the landing page, no auth required.
New public API POST /api/public/get-in-touch creates a Lead Depot lead attributed to the agent whose QR code the visitor scanned, and fires the standard new-lead admin/agent notification emails.
Fixed unformatted raw-digit phone number display on Get In Touch landing pages (header call button and post-submit success panel) - now renders (XXX) XXX-XXXX consistently.

Corrected a stale/incorrect phone number printed on Alex Watson's 'For Sale' yard sign artwork ((904) 608-1977 -> (904) 785-8147) and added each agent's Get In Touch QR code to the Alex, Nate, and Vonda yard sign PDFs.
__bundleNotes: The Get In Touch page is a static public HTML file (public/get-in-touch.html), not part of the SPA client bundle, so its own markup/phone-formatting logic is verified via the direct GET /get-in-touch/:id checks above plus the local/live Playwright renders done during development, rather than a Layer 2 bundle-string check.
